scope: The Voice Companion connection in Thunderbird updates by itself.

topics.title: Thunderbird connection updates by itself
details: Voice Companion keeps its link to Thunderbird up to date. When it gets a new one, Thunderbird restarts once by itself.
You hear that it is updating. Then you hear when it is done.
It never restarts while you write a message. If you opened Thunderbird yourself, it waits until you are back in Voice Companion.
You no longer need to close Thunderbird by hand.

topics.title: Messages about the connection
details: If a new feature needs the new link, you hear that it updates soon. You no longer hear to close Thunderbird.
